_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Abide in my love, the Lord says.
As the Father has loved me, so I love you.
You are no longer servants but friends.
He has called us friends.
Love one another as I have loved you.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Sing to the Lord a new song. Come, let us worship.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Sing something new this morning, you whom God has chosen, for the old griefs do not get the last word.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
He no longer calls you servant, kept at arm's length; he calls you friend, and tells you everything.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
He says, Abide in my love, and let my joy be in you, and let your joy be full.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
So love one another the way he first loved you, and watch the Spirit fall on every kind of person.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Sing to the Lord a new song.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
He calls us friends and tells us all he knows.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Abide in his love; let your joy be full.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Come, let us love as we are loved.
We are his friends. Alleluia!
